answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide on how to pay your **federal taxes online**:

---

## 💻 Federal Tax Payment Online – Your Options

### 1. 🏦 IRS Direct Pay *(Recommended – Free)*
Pay personal or business taxes directly from your bank account with IRS Direct Pay. It's free and secure.

- **Website:** [directpay.irs.gov](https://directpay.irs.gov)
- You can make secure payments directly from your bank account without fees, and you don't even need an IRS account to use it.
- You can pay your balance due, federal tax deposits, and other federal income tax.
- A single payment cannot exceed $10 million. For higher payments, use the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) or a same-day wire.

---

### 2. 🖥️ IRS Online Account
- You can pay your tax balance due, estimated payments, or part of a payment plan. Note that penalties and interest will continue to grow until you pay the full balance. You can pay now or schedule payments up to a year in advance.
- An IRS Online Account adds more tools, like seeing your balance, checking payment history, and using built-in Direct Pay features.
- **Website:** [IRS.gov/account](https://www.irs.gov/payments/your-online-account)

---

### 3. 🏢 EFTPS – Electronic Federal Tax Payment System *(Businesses & Existing Users)*
- The Electronic Federal Tax Payment System is a free service from the US Treasury that lets people and businesses pay federal taxes online from a bank account. It can send payments, schedule future dates, and show past activity. It still works well for large or repeated payments.
- ⚠️ **Important Update:** As of October 17, 2025, EFTPS stopped accepting new enrollments from individual taxpayers. People who already have accounts can keep using them. New personal payments must be made through IRS Direct Pay or the IRS Online Account.
- **Website:** [eftps.gov](https://www.eftps.gov)

---

### 4. 💳 Debit Card, Credit Card, or Digital Wallet
- You can pay for your federal taxes with your credit/debit card through a third-party payment processor. The processor charges a convenience fee.
- You can also explore digital wallets where supported.

---

### 5. 📱 IRS2Go Mobile App
- Use the IRS2Go mobile app for easy and secure mobile payments.

---

### 6. 💼 Payment Plan (Installment Agreement)
- If you can't pay by the deadline, you can request a payment plan.
- There are several plan types available, including: simple, streamlined, in-business trust fund express, guaranteed, and partial payment installment agreements.

---

### ⚠️ Key Reminders
- Payment for taxes you owe is due by the filing deadline, even if you get a filing extension.
- The IRS encourages you to pay your taxes in full because penalties and interest will continue to grow until you pay the full balance.
- Paying isn't the same as filing. You can e-file (submit the return) and still choose a separate payment method such as Direct Pay, card, online account, or a payment plan.
